New York hotel prices: median $191 a night with taxes and fees, 17 hotels priced Sep 25, 2026

These prices were read on September 25, 2026 for a stay of Oct 30 to Nov 1, 2026, which has passed. Check today's price for your dates

New York's median: $191 a night all-in, at 10 hotels for 2 adults, from $139 at Dynasty Hotel and Suites New York LaGuardia Hotel to $288 at Courtyard by Marriott Edgewater NYC Area.

Check a New York hotel for your dates or check any hotel's price

Google Hotels returned these 17 New York hotels, on 61 booking sites; New York's median was the 13th lowest of the 25 cities priced that day. Listed prices only: The Bay Ridge Hotel, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Newark Airport, Four Points by Sheraton Flushing, Holiday Inn Express & Suites Woodside LaGuardia Airport by IHG, DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Fort Lee - George Washington Bridge, The One Boutique Hotel and Hotel Indigo Lower East Side New York by IHG.

Our search was "hotels in New York", and Google Hotels returned hotels across the New York area. By their names, 5 of the 17 are near Newark Liberty or LaGuardia airport, 4 are in Queens or Brooklyn and 2 are in Fort Lee or Edgewater, New Jersey. So the median is the price of this mix of hotels around New York, not of a Manhattan hotel. Airports of New York: JFK and LaGuardia (LGA) in Queens, and Newark Liberty (EWR) in New Jersey.

The booking sites at New York hotels

61 sites, 16 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Booking.com at 16, Agoda at 12, Expedia.com at 11, Hotels.com at 11 and Priceline at 11. Fewest sites: Q4 Hotel New York City (3, as was 1 other); most: Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites New York Queens/Fresh Meadows (27, as was 1 other).

Booking.com was lowest at Q4 Hotel New York City of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 15. Agoda was lowest at The Bay Ridge Hotel of its 12, and 5%+ above another site at 11. Expedia.com was lowest at Paris Suites Hotel of its 11, and 5%+ above another site at 8.

The hotel's own site, at 10 of the 17: lowest at none, a median 28% above the lowest site. Nearest: Dynasty Hotel and Suites New York LaGuardia Hotel, $143 against $139 on Hotels.com. Farthest: Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites New York Queens/Fresh Meadows, $312 against $182 on Super.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 5, Billabook.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Hotels.com at 1, Hotelscombined.ie at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, KAYAK.ie at 1, momondo.ie at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate. Up to 28 listings were kept per hotel.

Taxes and fees in New York

They added a median of 17.0% ($28 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 14.5% at Hotel Executive Suites to 22.8% at Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites New York Queens/Fresh Meadows; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 7 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

New York, priced again a week later

Same stay, same New York hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 5 up, 1 down of 7; rose most Hilton Garden Inn New York/Staten Island, $131 to $154; fell most The Bay Ridge Hotel, $183 to $178; another site lowest at 6.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 9 up, 6 down of 18; rose most The Bay Ridge Hotel, $187 to $349; fell most The One Boutique Hotel, $285 to $244; another site lowest at 12.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about New York hotel prices

How much is a hotel in New York?

$191 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $139 at Dynasty Hotel and Suites New York LaGuardia Hotel to $288 at Courtyard by Marriott Edgewater NYC Area.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in New York?

No: these prices come from a few New York dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 9 New York hotels rose more than 2%, 6 fell; The Bay Ridge Hotel rose most, $187 to $349 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for New York hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (5 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 10.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.
